svg.aria-label: Resonance (valence-bond) view of colour: a donor–acceptor azo dye
svg.title: Resonance (valence-bond) view of colour: a donor–acceptor azo dye
svg.desc: Resonance forms of p-dimethylaminoazobenzene benzenoid and quinoid
svg.text: Resonance (valence-bond) view of colour: a donor–acceptor azo dye
Lone pair of the donor (–NMe₂) pushes through the ring to the azo group; form II contributes strongly to the excited state.
The more such polar, low-energy forms exist, the smaller the energy gap ΔE and the longer the wavelength absorbed.
